source: Hand-made for Control Finder on Oct 9, 2026; not from NIST. SP 800-53 doesn't answer these questions: the facts they ask for (fines, prices, products, vulnerability scores, history, code, or everyday topics) aren't in the catalog, even where a control is on a related subject. The right answer is that the question isn't covered. Half are security-adjacent, the hard half; half are unrelated.
